facts: Parties: Lowther Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Glenrock Media Ltd (Seller); the Company is Delamere Foods Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 27 March 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 June 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $44,062,500. The Purchase Price is $235,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Saltash Software Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $1,200,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
